rules.rationale: Published ESM chunks merge many modules, so a module-scope statement a bundler cannot prove pure (displayName assignments, plugin registration, prototype mixins, un-annotated React factories) pins its component and everything it references into every consumer bundle that touches the chunk.

evidence.note: Module-scope displayName, registerXYPlugin, and provideMarginalGraphics statements retained the chart for every consumer of its published chunk; pure initializers plus render-time registration cut the tree-shaken semiotic/xy Scatterplot import from 150 to 123 KB gzip (Rolldown with splitting).

The attachUpdateResultStore prototype mixin and a lowered static class field ran at module scope, so any import touching the XY frame chunk retained the whole store; replaced with a method-only base class and a module constant.

Inspect ordinary calls and constructions throughout module initializers, including nested arguments, callee expressions, exports, computed members and static initialization. Only unshadowed native collections over literal arrays, symbols, null-prototype objects and freezing fresh literals are exempt. Audited existing findings: schema builders, private caches, fixture calculations and renderer wrappers have no externally observable effects and now carry explicit PURE annotations; no findings are grandfathered.

Initializer traversal also found a globalThis registry assignment hidden inside a variable initializer. The registry now initializes on explicit registration, with tests proving inert imports/lookups and shared registration across module copies. Assignment/update/delete/await/tagged-template initializer work is now reported.
